GANESHVERSE FESTIVAL AUDIO ASSETS DIRECTORY
==================================================
Place your local / licensed Telugu Ganesh festival audio files here.
The centralized Festival Music Manager automatically detects and plays these files:

REQUIRED CORE AUDIO FILES:
1. jai_jai_ganesha.mp3
   - Primary devotional festival song
   - Automatically starts when Lord Ganesha is unveiled at the mandapam (after removing the cloth)
   - Plays continuously throughout festival stages

2. ganesha_aarti.mp3
   - Sacred Ganesha Aarti song (e.g., traditional Ganesh Aarathi)
   - Fades out festival music and plays during Stage 6 Aarti ceremony
   - Resumes festival music when Aarti concludes

3. bell.mp3
   - Authentic brass temple bell chime
   - Plays when interacting with / swinging hanging temple bells and during rituals

OPTIONAL ADDITIONAL TELUGU FESTIVAL SONGS:
The music manager automatically rotates smoothly through these additional supplied songs:
4. festival_song_1.mp3
5. festival_song_2.mp3
6. festival_song_3.mp3

NOTE:
If any mp3 file is not yet placed in this folder, the game's graceful procedural
audio fallback plays sacred temple chimes and gentle harmonious chords without crashing or stalling.
==================================================
